content:
Hi

1) Gmail allows a single email to have multiple labels assigned to them (All Mail, Inbox, Important). Thunderbird for Android treats the labels as distinct imap folders.

An email with all three labels with appear in all three imap folders (as though duplicated). Thunderbird treats these as independent emails. That's why you see three notifications.

You can enable/disable email notifications based upon the folder they exist within.

  1. Open the sidebar with your account and its folders showing
  2. Tap manage folders (bottom of list)
  3. Tap a folder's name (eg All Mai)
  4. Toggle Notifications Off/On (per your preference)

See screen shot

To avoid seeing duplicates, disable sync and notifications for "All Mail" and "Important". Emails should normally have at least one other label/imap folder such as Inbox.

2) It's not normal to see authentication errors every time you switch between networks.

You may see it occasionally if you use oAuth 2.0 authentication and the access token the app got from gmail expired and needs renewing.

  1. Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server
  2. Click Next

Are you using any VPN or security app on you phone? Is the cellular connection and signal strength in your area good? Are you using the apps push email service for immediate email notifications?

3) K9 and Thunderbird for Android are essentially the same app, bar theme colours. They're build by Thunderbird from the same code base. It's normal for them to look the same.
